Priya Nair: Quick thread to finalize GA SLOs + error-budget handling + who's on support for the first 2 weeks post-GA. Need to publish to the channel by Friday.
Ben Rodriguez: I propose we keep SLOs tight for prod: availability 99.95%, p99 latency < 350ms, error rate < 0.3%. Non-prod tiers get relaxed SLOs.
Claire Dupont: Sounds reasonable. Can we define what counts as 'availability' for model endpoints? (e.g., 5xx only or 4xx+5xx?)
Ravi Shah: We should exclude client-side 4xx except 429. Availability = successful 2xx/stream-chunks plus not-timed-out. Count 429 as throttled errors.
Ben Rodriguez: Agreed. Also define an error-budget burn policy: if we hit 50% of monthly budget in 72h -> automatic mitigation window (scale-up + fallback) and incident review. If 100% -> pause new customer onboards and exec alert.
Jules Tran: For billing and credits: if mitigation triggers fallback that reduces quality, give impacted customers a pro-rated credit equal to token-cost * 20% for free/dev tiers, and for paid prod tiers offer a service credit per contract. For enterprise, CSM will coordinate credits.
Priya Nair: We need a short checklist for GA acceptance: docs, runbooks, oncall rota, alerts, legal signoff on credits, pricing page updated, and e2e CI sim for fallback. Who volunteers?
Claire Dupont: I'll own docs + docs checklist. Will add a short "what to expect" FAQ and a snippet for customers explaining credits.
Ben Rodriguez: I'll own infra runbook and the error-budget policy doc.
Ravi Shah: I'll add alerts and dashboards. Need to standardize names: ga_slo_<tier>_<metric>. Also will create a burn-rate dashboard.
DeployBot: Deployment window available Fri 10:00-14:00 UTC. Will run pre-deploy smoke after rollout.
Jules Tran: I'll coordinate with Sales/CS for pricing language and the FAQ credit table.
Priya Nair: OK, add oncall: week1 primary oncall-platform, week2 rotate to product-oncall. Make sure PagerDuty escalation includes Eng SRE lead.
